name: acspeed
description: acspeed benchmarks how fast a cloud is to operate when an AI coding agent is driving it. A headless agent is given a real application, a real cloud account and a task; the run is timed end to end and the elapsed wall-clock is split into the part the cloud spent, the part the agent spent, and a remainder held by neither. The repository contains the harness, the task suite, and 94 published runs across AWS, GCP and Azure with the redacted agent transcript behind every reported number.
